hero.subtitle: I design and build web applications that are fast by default — from database schema to the last pixel. Next.js, TypeScript, and a healthy obsession with Lighthouse scores.

about.heading: About me
about.subtitle: Engineer, not just a coder
about.bio: I am a fullstack developer who cares about the full picture — from clean API design to smooth 60fps animations. I started with Java and Spring Boot, fell in love with the React ecosystem, and now I build end-to-end with Next.js and TypeScript. I believe great software is invisible: fast loads, intuitive interfaces, zero surprises.
about.current_focus: Server Components, edge computing, and building a SaaS starter kit with Stripe integration
